reviews.title: Premium case at an affordable price.
reviews.comment: Since my old case had very restrictive airflow (NZXT H500), I wanted to upgrade to one with a similar form factor to the Lian Li Lancool 207. The looks of this Okinos case, especially the wood detail, really caught my attention because of how elegant it looks. I’d also heard good things about Okinos, so I decided to give it a shot. I was pleasantly surprised by the build quality and the cleverness of the design. It’s basically a premium case at an affordable price. The materials feel high quality, almost all the panels can be removed without the need for thumbscrews, the airflow is insane (temps dropped by around 10 - 12 degrees), and my build looks hella clean in it. Since I never use the front panel connectors, I really liked the fact that it also includes rubber plugs to prevent dust buildup. One thing to keep in mind is that if you use stiff cable extensions like I do, cable management can get a bit tricky, but that has more to do with this type of form factor than with this case in particular. From what I saw in a Gamers Nexus review of the Lancool 207, that one seems much less forgiving. Very happy with my purchase and I’d definitely recommend it.
reviews.author: José D.

reviews.title: Simple and elegant
reviews.comment: This is an amazing case, beyond all expectations and I can’t picture a budget case out performing or looking as great as this case. -Easy to build in -Fans are excellent -mesh panels are easy to clean (big plus with the dog shedding) -Best of all, included two gpu support brackets for my 9060xt. Only con I can think of is the power button is just ok but this thing is just too amazing to pass up, no way it stays this price!
reviews.author: Ethan

reviews.title: Best case I have ever built in
reviews.comment: Just like the title says - spacious, easy to take off all the panels, super easy to build. Looks great. My system build is in the picture. HIGHLY recommend.
reviews.author: hans peter jensen

reviews.title: HIghly Recommend
reviews.comment: Great build quality for the price. The amount of airflow that you get in this case is insane. My GPU and CPU temps have dropped tremendously. It is easy to manage cables in this case. Will say the power button feels cheap, but other than that, this case is flawless.
reviews.author: Ben R

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.comment: Well built and good quality. Easy to build and airflow is great. My GPU dropped about 4c to 5c. I switched from the y70 touch. The price is priced very well. My aorus 4080 super master fits in the case so it should fit about any GPU. Very satisfied with this purchase. UPDATE!! I added some mesh I bought from Amazon and added to the area that was pulling air into the case for blocking dusts. I also cut a mesh out for the from mesh panel and stuck it inside. I didn't take a photo of that, but have photos for the other areas that was pulling in air. Peace of mind.
